thread.title: Wall Street Pushes Mostly Higher as S&P, Nasdaq Halt Four-Day Skids

author: MT Newswires
title: Wall Street Pushes Mostly Higher as S&P, Nasdaq Halt Four-Day Skids
text:
Shutterstock photo Equities in the U.S. were mostly higher on Monday, with the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite halting four-day losing streaks as optimism about more tax cuts helped overshadow a downbeat day for tech giant Apple ( AAPL ).
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was struggling to join its peers in the win column with Apple's loss weighing after the company came into the sights of President Donald Trump's tweeting over the weekend and Travelers Cos. ( TRV ) weakened as Atlantic coast states prepared for category four Hurricane Florence.
